Name: Beautiful Bachelors Rasmodius
Author: SeaQueen91
Description:
[b]Beautiful Bachelors: Rasmodius[/b] is an add-on portrait release for the Beautiful Bachelors series. It gives Stardew Valley’s Wizard a refined visual glow-up with a more romantic, stylish, and arcane fantasy look while still keeping him recognizable as Rasmodius.
I noticed there are a lot of beautiful portrait overhauls for the women of Stardew Valley, but far fewer focused on the men. This release was made for players who wanted Rasmodius to feel more handsome, magical, and visually appealing while still preserving his mysterious personality and wizardly presence.

The portraits were created using access to paid AI models, then further edited and refined in Photoshop to improve consistency, expression, details, background alignment, and usability in-game.
This release currently includes [b]Rasmodius[/b] with a full high-resolution portrait sheet designed for use with Portraiture.

Note: This does not include sprites. Fortunately, there are many great Rasmodius sprites out there already!

Installation Instructions[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI. [/*]
[*]Install the Portraiture mod and all of its requirements. [/*]
[*]Download and unzip [b]Beautiful Bachelors: Rasmodius[/b]. [/*]
[*]Place the Rasmodius portrait image into the appropriate Portraiture folder. [/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley. [/*]
[*]Speak to Rasmodius in-game and use Portraiture to select the Beautiful Bachelors portrait set. [/*]
[/list]For Portraiture, the folder path will usually look something like:
[code]Portraiture/Portraits/Beautiful Bachelors/Rasmodius[/code]You may need to press the [b]P[/b] key while speaking with Rasmodius to cycle to the correct portrait. For additional setup details, see the Portraiture mod page.
[heading]Main Features[/heading]
[b]Beautiful Bachelors: Rasmodius[/b] is a simple portrait image replacement set for Portraiture.
Features include:
[list]
[*]High-resolution Rasmodius portraits [/*]
[*]Romantic arcane fantasy “glow-up” artwork [/*]
[*]Multiple expressions for Rasmodius [/*]
[*]Portraiture-compatible image files [/*]
[*]Custom parchment-style portrait background [/*]
[*]No gameplay changes [/*]
[*]No dialogue changes [/*]
[*]No schedule changes [/*]
[*]Safe to install or uninstall whenever [/*]
[/list][heading]Requirements[/heading]
This mod requires:
[list]
[*]SMAPI [/*]
[*]Portraiture [/*]
[*]Any requirements needed by Portraiture [/*]
[/list][b]Beautiful Bachelors: Rasmodius[/b] does not work as a standalone portrait replacement without Portraiture. Be sure to place the image file into your Portraiture portraits folder, then use Portraiture in-game to select it.
